Here’s a polished rewrite of your email that keeps your warm tone but makes it smoother and more professional:  

---

**Subject:** Follow-Up & Next Steps  

Hi Anakarina,  

Thank you again for meeting with me today and for welcoming me into your team’s growth journey. I see exciting opportunities ahead for your brand, and I’d love for us to be a part of helping you get there.  

Attached is the adjusted growth plan we discussed. I’ve also scheduled our next check-in for October 15th so we can review progress and explore how we can best support you in moving this forward. Please don’t hesitate to reach out with any questions in the meantime.  

Most importantly, I hope your procedure goes smoothly and that your recovery week is restful and easy.  

Looking forward to connecting again soon,  
Bethany  

---  

Do you want me to also create a **shorter, more casual version** you can send if you’d prefer it to feel less formal?
